name: 1Password
description: 1Password is a unified access management platform, described by the vendor as "the most trusted vault for identities, credentials, and secrets," securing credentials and secrets for humans, AI agents, and machines.
best_for: Positioned for organizations — from individual users to large enterprises — that need to manage access, credentials, and secrets across complex environments, including human and machine/AI-agent identities.

alternatives.name: Bitwarden
alternatives.description: Open-source password manager with transparent zero-knowledge encryption.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and teams seeking open-source security and self-hosting

alternatives.name: Keeper
alternatives.description: Zero-trust enterprise password manager with BreachWatch dark web alerts.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises needing zero-trust security and secrets management

alternatives.name: Dashlane
alternatives.description: Password manager featuring integrated VPN and dark web monitoring.
alternatives.best_for: Users wanting built-in VPN privacy alongside password security

tiers.name: Teams Starter Pack
tiers.notes: $24.95/month paid annually; includes 10 members. Additional seats up to 20 total are $4.99/member/month on annual billing.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: $8.99/user/month paid annually; adds broader administration, identity-provider integrations, reporting, and role-based permissions.
